about: Compact copy of three light curves from eumemic/exoplanets video/public/data/lc.json (commit da72261; data CC BY 4.0, eumemic): tic4206066 (key rabtsevich: Sectors 6, 32 and 98, 30-minute bins, and the two fitted signals), l9859 (L 98-59, 12 days of Sector 2) and inverted (TIC 37904598's light curve turned upside down, and the false alarm found in it). Times: t = t0 + cumulative sum of dt, in units of 0.0001 day (BTJD = BJD - 2457000). Flux f in ppm relative to the median, rounded to 1 ppm. Key 'search' was added by Foundation0 (see its own note).

search.about: Computed by Foundation0 from tic4206066 above: a fixed-width box search (box 1.6978 h) over 373,825 trial periods from 1 to 13 days, evenly spaced in log period; for each of 720 log-period bins, the highest signal-to-noise ratio found (snr) and the trial period that gave it (P). SNR = (mean flux - mean flux in the box) / (std of all points / sqrt(points in the box)).
